name: @neuropause/commercial
description: NeuroPause Enterprise Management System — Wave 13 Enterprise Commercial Platform. Composes Waves 1-12 (unchanged) into a commercial, multi-tenant SaaS product organizations can purchase, provision, operate, and scale: a commercial runtime + customer/tenant registry, multi-tenant provisioning (reusing Wave 6 federation), customer onboarding, a licensing platform, subscription representation, usage metering, feature flags, white-labeling, a deployment manager (reusing Wave 7 cloud-ops), an upgrade manager, marketplace commerce (reusing the Wave 6 federation marketplace), customer administration, a customer-success platform (reusing the Wave 8 business customer-success runtime), a support platform, observability (reusing the operations base package), commercial analytics (real data only), an enterprise API surface, and an SDK. Tenant runtime/provisioning/licensing/feature-flags/white-label/deployment-manager/upgrade-manager/marketplace-commerce/support/SDK/governance are LIVE-VERIFIED in-process; external payment/marketplace providers (Stripe/Razorpay/PayPal/Azure/AWS/GCP marketplaces) are ADAPTER-VERIFIED until configured; customers/revenue/contracts/billing/renewals/usage are BUSINESS-DATA-PENDING (never fabricated; analytics show real commercial data only); and live payment settlement, tax remittance, marketplace payouts, and banking reconciliation are REGULATED-EXTERNAL — represented only. Every commercial action is audited on the one chain with a replay id.
